It’s clear that obesity is a complex disease that must be managed through a focus on overall health 
and well-being, not just by changing a number on the scale. Issues around weight bias and stigma 
must be addressed. Our current health system must improve to support individuals regardless 
of body shape and size. And current cultural narratives around obesity must change to remove 
assumptions of weakness or lack of willpower as causes of obesity and eliminate attitudes that cast 
blame and shame on people living with obesity.24
